title: Features
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM
The Respond Credit Rating Query retrieves the credit rating information from the SAP Credit Management component.

Features

The Query Credit Rating outbound services operation sends the debtor’s rating that is calculated in contract accounting to the
SAP Credit Management process component. This operation also requests the credit rating calculated in SAP Credit Management.

Message Types

e FICA Rating Replicate Query

Notes on SAP Implementation

This outbound service operation is called from the following transactions in the contract accounting back-end system:

e Replication of Score ( FPCM2 ): The calculated rating of the debtors is sent asynchronously to the Credit Management
system. The Credit Management system returns the overall credit rating of the debtors to the contract accounting system
asynchronously.

e Preparation of Master Data Change ( FPBPCR ): The calculated rating of the debtors is sent asynchronously to the credit

management system. The credit management system sends back the credit management master data that is relevant for a
later change of the contract account master data (with transaction FPBPCU ).

To enhance the proxy structure of this operation you can use the FI-CA event 4612.
Configuration

You need to activate the integration with credit management before you can use the contract accounting transactions to send the

outbound service operation. You can do so in Customizing for Financial Accounting under Financial Supply Chain Management ->
Credit Management -> Activate Credit Management
